column12: Carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and particularly relates to a carbon-supported ruthenium alloy hydrogen evolution catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method, catalytic sites are exposed to the maximum extent, intrinsic catalytic activity is further improved through an alloying strategy, excellent hydrogen evolution activity is shown, and when being used as a cathode material for an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device, the composite material can directly replace a commercial platinum-carbon catalyst, and the service life of the composite material is prolonged. Good application prospects are shown in ethanol-assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production and anion exchange membrane electrolysis cells.

column12: METHOD OF OBTAINING CERIUM DIOXIDE

column12: Method for preparing high-purity sulfur-manganese solution through electrochemical deep purification and magnesium removal
column13: The invention provides a method for preparing a high-purity sulfur-manganese solution by electrochemical deep purification and magnesium removal, which belongs to the technical field of extraction metallurgy, and comprises the following steps: manganese-magnesium purification and separation are carried out in a double-chamber diaphragm electrolytic cell, a current collector loaded with a magnesium-poor ion sieve is used as a cathode to be inserted into a purification chamber, and a magnesium-containing manganese sulfate solution is discharged; taking a current collector loaded with a magnesium-rich ion sieve as an anode, inserting the anode into the enrichment chamber, discharging the anode into the supporting electrolyte, and separating by using an anion exchange membrane; direct current is introduced between the electrodes, Mg < 2 + > in the purification chamber is embedded into the magnesium-poor-state ion sieve under the driving of external potential, and magnesium in the magnesium-rich-state ion sieve is separated out in an ion form and enters the supporting electrolyte; after one-time charging and discharging are completed, direct current is introduced after the relative positions of the electrodes are changed, the next cycle is started, and finally the high-purity sulfur-manganese solution is obtained. The method has the continuity and stability of a chemical method, no impurity elements are introduced in the preparation process, no waste residues are generated, and the method has the advantages of being easy to operate, stable in operation, environmentally friendly, economical and feasible.

column12: METHOD OF MANUFACTURING LITHIUM HYDROXIDE
column13:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve problems that a manufacturing method high in economic efficiency and effective to assure stably lithium hydroxide which cannot be stored for a long period and is produced overseas, as needed from a lithium source in which a domestic stockpile is possible, has been expected.

SOLUTION: An electrodialyzer is used. In the electrodialyzer, cation exchange membranes and anion exchange membranes are alternately arranged between an anode and a cathode, following an anode chamber zoned by the anode and the cation membrane one or more groups consisting of an acid chamber, a salt chamber, an alkali chamber, and a water electrolysis chamber are arranged, and the water electrolysis chamber constituted by the anion membrane of the most cathode side is zoned by the cathode instead of the cation membrane as a cathode chamber. A method of manufacturing lithium hydroxide includes supplying an aqueous solution of lithium salt to the salt chamber, taking out an acid from the acid chamber, and taking out a lithium hydroxide solution from the alkali chamber. Further, a method of manufacturing high-pure lithium hydroxide, which gives a purification process reducing minute quantities of impurities mixed, is provided. Lithium hydroxide can be manufactured cleanly, simply and easily as needed from lithium salts and lithium carbonate which can be stockpiled in Japan. The method of manufacturing lithium hydroxide which is high in convenience and general versatility is provided.

column12: PRODUCTION OF ALKALI HYDROXIDE
column13: PURPOSE:To produce an aq. alkali hydroxide soln. having a high concn. and an aq. acid soln. with superior current efficiency when an aq. soln. of an alkali metal salt is electrolyzed to produce an aq. alkali hydroxide soln., by using a three-chamber type electrolytic cell provided with a cation exchange membrane having a specified multilayered structure. CONSTITUTION:When an aq. soln. of an alkali metal salt such as Na2SO4 is electrolyzed in a diaphragm system electrolytic cell to produce 35-55wt.% aq. NaOH soln. from the cathode and an aq. NaOH soln., e.g., a sulfonated styrene-divinylbenzene copolymer or a fluorine-contg. linear polymer having -SO3M or -OM groups (M is an alkali metal). The cation exchange membrane is stretched in the cell so that the first layer confronts the cathode.

column12: Thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode as well as preparation method and application of thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable-phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure composite electrode
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a thermal shock induced ferrocobalt double-doped metastable phase nickel/nickel oxide heterostructure (Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF) composite electrode. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cutting and cleaning the foamed nickel substrate; the preparation method comprises the following steps: growing a nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet on a foamed nickel substrate through a constant-voltage deposition method; nickel-cobalt-iron prussian blue analogue nanoparticles grow in situ on the surface of the nickel-cobalt-iron layered double hydroxide nanosheet through an ion exchange method; and preparing the Co, Fe-Ni/NiO/NF composite electrode through a thermal shock method. The composite electrode has excellent catalytic activity and stability as a working electrode for hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution reactions. The composite electrode can be directly used as a cathode and an anode of an anion-exchange membrane electrolytic cell to efficiently catalyze a full-water decomposition reaction at different temperatures, and the electrolytic cell can stably operate for 1000 hours and 240 hours under the current densities of 0.1 A cm <-2 > and 1.0 A cm <-2 > respectively, so that the composite electrode has a good application prospect.

column12: Electrochemistry method for simultaneously producing sodium chlorate and alkaline peroxide
column13: The invention relates to an electrochemical method which produces sodium chloride and alkaline hydrogen peroxide simultaneously. The method can improve the use efficiency of the two poles of the electricity, and lower the production cost. The method adopts an electrolytic tank consisting of an anode, a cation exchange membrane, an anion exchange membrane and a cathode, wherein, the electrodes combine with the membranes in sequence to form an anode chamber, an intermediate chamber and a cathode chamber; sodium chloride solution and sodium chlorate solution are circulated to the anode chamber, sodium hydroxide solution and air is circulated to the cathode chamber and sodium hydroxide solution is circulated to the intermediate chamber; after direct current circulating among the electrodes, chlorine is produced in the anode while the oxygen in the cathode deoxidizes and produces hydrogen peroxide and the concentration of the sodium hydroxide solution in the intermediate chamber is increased; the anolyte flowing out of the anode chamber flows into an external heated reaction tank, and chlorine is transferred into sodium chlorate; the anolyte is circulated back to the anode chamber of the electrolytic tank; a part of the concentrated sodium hydroxide solution which flows out of the intermediate chamber can be used for adjusting the pH value of the anolyte without using extra sodium hydroxide, thereby lowering the running cost.

column12: Selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a selenium vacancy-containing high-entropy selenide catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst is prepared from a nickel-based base material and a high-entropy selenide on the surface of the nickel-based base material, wherein the high-entropy selenide is (FeCoNiVCrMn) Se < 2 >. According to the method, Fe, Co, Ni, V, Cr and Mn metal salts are prepared into a mixed precursor solution, a multi-metal precursor layer is formed on the surface of a nickel-based substrate through electro-deposition, and then Joule heating rapid annealing is adopted in the presence of an inert atmosphere and a selenium source, so that high-entropy selenylation and Se vacancy construction are realized. In the catalyst, Se vacancy can promote water molecule activation and improve hydrogen evolution performance; in the oxygen evolution process, the surface of the catalyst is subjected to in-situ reconstruction to form a high-entropy hydroxide active phase, and a SeO4 < 2-> interface layer is synchronously generated/anchored and used for regulating reaction intermediate adsorption and inhibiting metal dissolution and Cl <-> corrosion. column12: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
column13: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. The perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst is composed of a main phase perovskite oxide substrate with electrochemical activity and a nanosheet proton conductor beta-NaFeO2 with excellent proton affinity. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

column12: Self-generating coupling waste battery lithium recovery and flue gas carbon capture system and method
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of resource recycling and carbon capture, and particularly discloses a self-power-generation coupled waste battery lithium recovery and flue gas carbon capture system and method. The system comprises a flow battery separated by an anion exchange membrane, the negative electrode side is provided with a waste lithium iron phosphate pole piece and an electrolyte chamber, and the positive electrode side is provided with a metal-based catalyst and a gas chamber. The method comprises the following steps: directly taking a waste pole piece as a negative electrode, and performing oxidation reaction under the driving of potential difference to release lithium ions; meanwhile, flue gas is introduced into the positive electrode side, oxygen is reduced on the surface of the catalyst to generate hydroxyl radicals, and then CO2 is captured and converted into carbonate radicals; and the carbonate is migrated to the negative electrode side to be combined with lithium ions to generate lithium carbonate. Self power generation is achieved based on the potential difference of positive electrode oxygen reduction and negative electrode lithium oxidation, an external power source is not needed, efficient recovery of lithium resources and carbon capture of flue gas are synchronously completed, and the method has the advantages of being simple in process, low in cost and environmentally friendly.

column12: Ultralow-energy-consumption carbon dioxide electrochemical trapping method and system
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemistry, and particularly relates to an ultralow-energy-consumption CO2 electrochemical trapping system. The system comprises an anode region, a cathode region and an anion exchange membrane arranged between the anode region and the cathode region, wherein the cathode region is filled with alkali liquor; a water-soluble organic photon coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactant is added into the anode region, and an external power supply is communicated between the anode region and the cathode region. The external power supply provides electric energy for the electrolytic cell. The cathode side is a hydrogen evolution electrode, and electrochemical reduction reaction is carried out to decompose water to generate H2 and OH <->; h < + > electrochemically generated on the anode side reacts with HCO3 <-> in anode liquor in a CO2 desorption tower to generate high-purity CO2 and water, so that purification desorption of CO2 is realized, and a substance Q rich in an organic PCET oxidation state enters a reduction regeneration tower for non-electrochemical reduction regeneration. The system can stably operate under low energy consumption, can capture CO2 in flue gas, and can also be applied to capture CO2 in factory waste gas, transportation tail gas, atmosphere and other environments.

column12: Laminated electrode device for electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide capture liquid
column13: The invention belongs to the field of integration of carbon dioxide capture and electrocatalytic utilization, and particularly relates to a laminated electrode device for electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide capture liquid. The electrode device comprises a cathode gas diversion layer, a cathode gas-liquid separation layer, a cathode liquid diversion layer, a cathode catalyst layer, a cation exchange membrane, an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer, an anode liquid diversion layer, an anode gas-liquid separation layer and an anode gas diversion layer which are sequentially laminated. According to the laminated electrode device provided by the invention, the independent flow guide of the cathode trapping liquid and the anode electrolyte is realized, an external flow field plate is not needed, and the reactor structure is simplified. And meanwhile, in-situ autonomous separation of cathode and anode gas products in the electrode is realized, gas retention and product crossing are avoided, and a subsequent separation unit is omitted. Besides, through the unique layered structure design, electron conduction, ion transmission and diffusion mass transfer of reactants/products are synergistically optimized, the internal resistance is reduced, and the reaction efficiency and stability are improved.

column12: Integrated disinfectant generating device for hydrogen peroxide and hypochlorous acid

According to the utility model, wet air can be separated into purified water and dry air without additionally providing a water source, and two disinfection products, namely hydrogen peroxide and hypochlorous acid, can be produced at the same time, so that two disinfection products in one mode are realized, and the application of the device in the public disinfection field is greatly promoted.

column12: HYBRID ELECTROCHEMICAL SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CARBON DIOXIDE CAPTURE
column13: A system for capturing and separating carbon dioxide (CO₂) from various sources includes a hydration unit, an electrochemical device, and a recirculation system. The hydration unit uses CO₂ hydration catalysts to dissolve CO₂ into an electrolyte solution, forming CO₂-derived ions, which are then separated by the electrochemical device. The electrochemical device, operating similarly to a supercapacitor, applies a voltage bias to store CO₂-derived ions and gaseous CO₂ within porous electrodes. Upon adjustment or removal of the voltage bias, CO₂ is desorbed and collected as gas. The electrolyte solution is recirculated for continuous CO₂ capture. This system provides efficient CO₂ capture and separation, suitable for direct air capture, gas capture, and ocean CO₂ capture, while optimizing performance, cost-effectiveness, and efficiency.

column12: Ni-NiO/CeO2 heterojunction nano-catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof

The catalyst is prepared by taking nickel and cerium ions as precursors through a one-step controllable incomplete reduction method, the process is simple, the yield is close to 100%, and the catalyst is suitable for mass production. In the catalyst, CeO2 effectively promotes water molecule dissociation, NiO species finely regulates and controls a hydrogen intermediate (H *) adjacent to a nickel active site to adsorb free energy, the bottleneck problems that a traditional nickel-based material is too high in H * adsorption and slow in water dissociation kinetics are synergistically solved, the catalyst shows excellent hydrogen evolution reaction activity in a 1M KOH electrolyte, and the catalyst can be applied to the field of hydrogen production. The overpotential is only 62 mV (relative to a reversible hydrogen electrode) under the current density of 10 mA cm <-2 >, and the performance is equivalent to that of a commercial 60% Pt/C catalyst; after the electrode is pressed into an integral electrode, the electrode can stably run for 300 hours under the ultrahigh current density of 1A cm <-2 > without activity attenuation. column12: Carbon capture using electrochemically-produced acid and base
column13: A method of making a material for capturing carbon dioxide from the earth's atmosphere, comprises producing an acid and a base with an electrochemical acid-base generator; dissolving a mineral in the acid to produce a mineral rich solution, separating silica from the mineral rich solution to form a silica depleted solution; adding a first portion of the base to the silica depleted solution to remove impurities by precipitation, adding a second portion of the base until ferrous hydroxide (Fe(OH)2) precipitates, then pausing base addition and removing the ferrous hydroxide precipitate from the solution. Then adding a third portion of the base to the iron-depleted solution to precipitate magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)2) and/or calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2). Then recovering a salt solution and directing the recovered salt solution to the electrochemical acid-base generator to produce a new acid and a new base. The magnesium hydroxide and/or calcium hydroxide may be used to capture and sequester carbon dioxide from a CO2-containing gas (e.g., air) by forming a carbonate or from the ocean by forming bicarbonate.

CONSTITUTION:The anode 1, the anion-exchange membrane 2, the cation-exchange membrane 3 and the anode 4 are fixed by a frame 5, and the respective gaps are used as the anode chamber 6, the salt chamber 7 and the cathode chamber 8. Brine is supplied to the chamber 7 from the brine storage tank 10. The line 11 from a water tap is branched into three lines, one of the lines passes through the chamber 6, one line passes through the chamber 8, and then the three lines are joined. The degasifier 12 is provided to the line passing through the chamber 8 before the junction. Water is supplied to the chambers 6 and 8, a DC voltage is impressed between the electrodes 1 and 4, hence NaOH and H2 are generated in the chamber 8, the materials are moved by the water from the line 11 into the degasifier 12, and the H2 is removed and discharged. Consequently, a dil, soln. of NaOH and Cl2 is obtained at the junction 11a.

column12: Full-spectrum solar frequency-division photovoltaic photo-thermal hydrogen-electricity co-production system and method
column13: The invention provides a full-spectrum solar frequency-division photovoltaic photo-thermal hydrogen-electricity co-production system and method, and belongs to the technical field of new energy. The system comprises a sunlight distribution module, a photo-thermal chemical module, a photovoltaic power generation module, a light condensation and heat collection module and a separation module. The photo-thermal chemical module comprises a rotatable spatially separated photo-thermal reaction tube formed by splicing an upper part and a lower part, and the inner wall of the photo-thermal chemical module is coated with an oxygen carrier. The photovoltaic power generation module comprises a photovoltaic panel and an anion exchange membrane alkaline electrolytic cell connected with the photovoltaic panel. And the light condensation and heat collection module is connected with the photovoltaic panel and the photo-thermal reaction tube. column12: Fuel cell system for low pressure operation
column13: This invention is an improved fuel cell design for use at low pressure. The invention has a reduced number of component parts to reduce fabrication costs, as well as a simpler design that permits the size of the system to be reduced at the same time as performance is being improved. In the present design, an adjacent anode and cathode pair are fabricated using a common conductive element, with that conductive element serving to conduct the current from one cell to the adjacent one. This produces a small and simple system suitable for operating with gas fuels or alternatively directly with liquid fuels, such as methanol, dimethoxymethane, or trimethoxymethane. The use of these liquid fuels permits the storage of more energy in less volume while at the same time eliminating the need for handling compressed gases which further simplifies the fuel cell system. The electrical power output of the design of this invention can be further increased by adding a passage for cooling the stack through contact with a coolant.

column12: PtRu nanocage as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a PtRu nanocage and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) adsorbing ruthenium chloride and chloroplatinic acid to ZIF-8 to form a PtRu ZIF-8 composite material; (2) performing high-temperature calcination on the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material in a hydrogen-argon reducing atmosphere to reduce the PtRu-ZIF-8 composite material into metal Ru and Pt, and forming an intermetallic compound by Zn generated by decomposition of ZIF-8, Ru and Pt to obtain a PtRuZn composite material; and (3) selectively etching the PtRuZn composite material by using a hydrochloric acid solution to remove Zn so as to obtain the PtRu nanocage with the cage-shaped structure. The method is easy and convenient to operate, the catalytic activity can be remarkably improved, and the Pt dosage can be greatly reduced. The material is suitable for AEMWE, and a new solution is provided for developing a low-cost and high-stability water electrolysis hydrogen production technology.

column12: NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: removing oil stain and an oxide layer on the surface of foamed nickel; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel nitrate and ammonium molybdate in deionized water, putting the solution and foamed nickel into a high-pressure reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction, and growing NiMoO4 on a foamed nickel substrate in situ; after the reaction is finished, cleaning and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with NiMoO4; soaking the Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam in a ferric salt solution to obtain Fe-NiMoO4-loaded nickel foam; and soaking the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x catalyst in alkali liquor, cleaning and drying to obtain the NiMoO4-coated NiFe (OH) x hierarchical structure catalyst. The preparation method is simple and safe, large-scale production can be achieved, and the prepared catalyst has a three-dimensional hierarchical structure and shows excellent catalytic performance and stability in a three-electrode system and an AEMWE electrolytic cell.
